messages:
evan: Quick sync 11 landing + launch routing. Need final copy and form rules by Friday so growth can wire up GTM.
priya: Top priorities: hero one-liner, three CTAs (self-serve, capacity review, enterprise contact), and a short benchmark callout for Hosted. Keep claims conservative.
sam: Draft hero (benefit): "Run production LLMs without managing infra". Draft hero (ROI): "Reduce per-token costs and predictable latency for customer-facing LLMs". Which variant do we test first?
jules: I prefer benefit-first for PLG traffic, ROI for outbound pages. We'll A/B both on the Hosted page.
rachel: For Dedicated: headline should call out "reserved GPU pools" + "SLA options". CTA: "Schedule capacity review" -> routes to AE form with company size and expected qps fields.
evan: Private page needs a security-first microcopy: "VPC, KMS, and audit logs for regulated workloads". Add optional checkbox: "I need on-prem/air-gapped" which triggers Security AE routing.
priya: Form routing rules (sketch):
- If product = Hosted -> show "Start free" and secondary "Join webinar". Self-serve signup by default.
- If product = Dedicated and company_size >= 200 or expected_qps > 1000 -> route to AE (high priority).
- If "on-prem/air-gapped" checked -> route to Security+Sales.
sam: Event snippet for tracking leads (put in growth doc):
```
// event for lead funnel
analytics.track('lead_submitted', {
  product: 'dedicated',
  company_size: '500'
})
```
jules: Webinar plan: one technical deep dive (runtime internals, caching, batching), one customer panel (cost & latency tradeoffs), 30min + 15min Q&A. We should promote on Hosted page as gateway to qualification.
rachel: Benchmark narrative: show server-side throughput and a cost per 1M tokens example using common configs; add legal/infrastructure approval step. Use neutral phrasing: "benchmarks on common GPU classes, results vary by model".
evan: CTA microcopy suggestions: Hosted primary: "Start free"; secondary: "Register for webinar" (list next event date). Dedicated primary: "Request capacity review" (AE response within 48 hrs). Private primary: "Contact sales" with extra note "compliance teams welcome".
priya: Design tweaks: three-panel hero with icons, stack-ranked benefits, and a small benchmark pill for Hosted (non-specific). Mobile-first: stack cards vertically, emphasize CTAs.
sam: Measurement plan: measure conversion to signup (Hosted), demo requests (Dedicated), and MQLs (Private). Run the headline A/B for 2 weeks or until 5k visitors.
jules: Copy ops: I'll produce 2 headline variants per page and a 3-line elevator for feature blocks. Need product review by Thurs.
rachel: Legal reminder: any explicit hardware or latency numbers require infra + legal signoff. Use "typical" or "verified on common configurations" until approved.
evan: Action items: 1) jules/sam produce headlines + microcopy by Wed EOD. 2) priya to publish form routing spec and tracking events. 3) rachel to coordinate benchmark wording approvals. 4) design to deliver hero mocks by Thurs.
launchbot: Reminder: set UTM parameters for launch emails and tag webinar signups with utm_campaign=landing_launch_188123.
evan: Great work team 11 ping on thread with blockers. :rocket:
